messages:
Nora Patel: Drafting a concise go-live one-pager for customers: prefill, batching presets, streaming fallback, and a renewal-check trigger. Keep it copy-paste friendly for AEs.
Sam Green: Love it. One-sentence opener + 3 customer bullets + 1-line fallback message. Engineers get a tiny appendix.
Nora Patel: Customer opener: "Well prefill a representative sample of your prompts, maintain a small warm pool for core flows, and switch to polling if streaming becomes unstable. Well monitor a few simple metrics and reach out proactively."
Ivy Lee: Add renewal signal: if weekly active sessions < 60% of expected by day 10, flag for outreach and run a 1-question micro-survey.
Sam Green: ENG presets (copyable):
- latency-first: batch_window_ms=50, max_batch_tokens=512
- balanced: batch_window_ms=150, max_batch_tokens=2048
- cost-saver: batch_window_ms=300, max_batch_tokens=4096
Nora Patel: Small prefill snippet customers can paste (non-prod first):
```
# PREFILL (non-prod first)
prefill_enabled: true
sample_strategy: stratified
sample_size: 150
warm_pool_size: 4
warm_pool_ttl_hours: 72
```
Ivy Lee: Observability (customer-friendly): prefill_success_rate >= 90%, cache_hit_rate >= 60%, p95_time_to_first_token_ms < 800, stream_disconnects_per_10k < 10. If breached, follow escalation.
Sam Green: Escalation playbook (3 steps): 1) CS collects 3 failing prompts and repros in non-prod. 2) ENG checks cache keys & model pin. 3) ENG oncall attaches traces and enables polling fallback.
Nora Patel: Tiny PromQL for p95 TTF (appendix): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/onepager-activation-prefetch-batching (access: customer-success, eng).
Ivy Lee: Customer fallback line to include in UI: "Were temporarily using polling to keep responses stable while we investigate streaming interruptions."
Nora Patel: Action items: @Sam finalize presets + curl example; @Ivy add micro-survey question; Ill assemble and publish the one-pager.
